mentions.name: AVC-LAN infotainment integration module
mentions.description: A board for integrating modern phones with Toyota/Lexus AVC-LAN infotainment systems. Version 1 is an existing prototype board demonstrated in videos; version 2 is being built around a CM4 IO board and will include the builder's own AVC-LAN implementation, a DAC, and GPS, and is intended to run AOSP Android. The board design is complete and work on the custom Android build is underway.
mentions.source_excerpt:

Version 2 is being built around a CM4 IO board and will include my AVCLAN implementation, DAC, GPS and is intended to run AOSP Android.  The board is fully designed already and I'm working on the custom Android build now.
